bids.implementation_plan: 进场后先完成设计接口清单核对与现场测量复核，随后按三段流水展开：路基过渡与挡土结构先行，结构衔接段跟进，交通节点改造与临时交通组织同步穿插。关键线路为挡土结构与结构衔接段，进度计划留协调余量，不做过满承诺。临时交通组织按分幅倒边、不断流编制，夜间与周末窗口提前向相关持份者通报。材料采购按统一工程量清单与单价分析表编制，材料价格调整机制按指数触发、设上下限并明确基准期，作为投标条件写入。质量与安全岗位按计划配置，独立检查与隐蔽工程复核节点在施工前锁定，检查记录与材料质量证明随批次归档。现金流按保守假设测算，支付条件在合同条款中逐项锁定。
bids.schedule_commitment: 总工期按项目24个月框架编排，本包施工期与前后包接口协调后锁定。关键线路为挡土结构与结构衔接段，进度计划留协调余量，不做过满承诺。临时交通组织按分阶段导改，夜间与周末窗口提前报批。管线迁改接口按设计接口清单逐项挂接，清单未明确处按单点计价不重复原则在澄清阶段确认，工期相应留弹性。质量与安全岗位到岗安排以团队可用性摘要为准，独立检查与复核节点不因工期压力压缩。
bids.compliance_statement: 接受业主按统一工程量清单与单价分析表进行计价与支付审核，单点计价不重复。材料价格调整机制建议按指数触发、设上下限并明确基准期，作为投标条件写入合同。质量与安全岗位按计划配置表述，实际到岗人员与独立检查分工以团队可用性摘要为准，该摘要作为附件后续补入。检验与文档管理费用在报价基础中单列，检查记录与材料质量证明随批次归档，接受业主按批次核查。管线迁改与疏解按设计接口清单承接，清单未明确处按单点计价不重复原则在澄清阶段确认，报价与工期已预留协调弹性。
bids.risk_response: 主要风险及应对：一、管线迁改接口边界在情景记录中未明确，已作为披露假设写入投标条件，报价与工期预留协调弹性，澄清阶段按单点计价不重复原则确认；二、质量与安全岗位实际到岗安排尚无团队可用性摘要支撑，投标文件按计划配置表述，不写成已到位，管理费与风险预留按保守口径计取；三、材料与人工价格上行，通过指数触发、设上下限并明确基准期的调价机制保留弹性；四、临时交通组织不断流约束，按分幅倒边与夜间周末窗口编排，并建立持份者沟通机制；五、现金流按保守假设测算，支付条件在合同条款中逐项锁定。

本投标以单一责任主体身份提交，服务范围严格限定为造价咨询与合同成本管理：工程量清单审核、变更计价技术评估与独立复核、支付申请独立复核、成本预警与变更评估、计量确认独立检查记录、成果复核节点与文档归档；不包含政府审批与现场监理，亦不越界承诺任何审批结果。

独立复核链是本方案的核心：支付申请复核、计量确认独立检查与变更计价技术评估由三名分离人员分别签认，计价编制人员不参与对其自身成果的复核；每份独立检查记录载明复核人、复核日期、依据版本与结论，形成可追溯的签认链。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: Scope remains exactly as stated: about 18,500 square metres of subgrade treatment, pavement structural layers, drainage and ancillary civil works, including temporary traffic diversion and utility diversion implementation within this package; excluding the bridge start and end structural connection sections. This package self-procures materials. The contractor shall implement temporary traffic diversion on a submit-first-then-commence basis, staged submission and staged implementation, and shall record the diversion submission objects, staged submission nodes and public information arrangements in the coordination clause as a binding obligation subject to owner review; these are obligations, not completed approvals. The contractor shall maintain an interface coordination register with MEP and drainage interface parties and shall sequence work after interface data is available. Utility diversion base data is per the tender documents actually provided; where data is insufficient the contractor shall keep the critical path moving on workable sections without stopping the whole line, and shall bear the coordination and rework boundary as an accepted risk allocation. The contractor shall complete emergency drills and crew training before the rainy season and shall provide temporary sedimentation and flow diversion at drainage interfaces. The team availability summary and the draft work-sequence and independent inspection node list are accepted as proposed-input statements only; they shall be firmed up as quality plan attachments during delivery and are not a condition of this acceptance.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: The contract price is 74,620,000 MOP, fixed for the stated scope, and remains unchanged in price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitments. Measurement, valuation and payment under this contract shall be governed solely by the unified bill-of-quantities basis and the price adjustment factors and base values issued under cost consulting package COMP-0169. Any basis, index treatment or risk boundary stated in the bidder submission is for quotation explanation only and shall not override or supplement the COMP-0169 basis. Pending issuance of the COMP-0169 basis text, the parties shall adopt it without change to price, currency, scope, members or resource commitments. The provisional sum shall be used per the COMP-0169 basis once issued and only for owner-instructed changes and unforeseeable matters, not diverted to other uses. Price adjustment uses material index 1.0545 and labor index 1.0980 as base values with adjustable factors per the owner bill-of-quantities basis; upward exposure is covered by the risk reserve together with the price adjustment clause. Safety and environmental投入 is a non-compressible cost and shall not be reduced. No uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope; any request requiring a change to price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares or resource commitments remains unresolved and needs re-tendering.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in MOP against measured quantities valued solely on the COMP-0169 unified bill-of-quantities basis, subject to owner measurement and payment review. Milestone-linked payment events are: submission of the traffic diversion plan and construction preparation by month 3; completion of main subgrade treatment by month 9; completion of drainage, ancillary civil works and utility diversion implementation by month 16; completion of pavement structural layers by month 21; and completion of testing, as-built documentation and handover by month 24. Each milestone payment is conditional on owner acceptance of the corresponding verified records, including layered subgrade compaction and settlement observation records, layer-by-layer pavement inspection and acceptance, witness sampling ledgers and batch traceability submitted with progress reports. The provisional sum is paid only against owner written instruction. The contractor shall not reduce inspection frequency to accelerate work.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: The contractor shall complete all construction content of this package within 24 months from commencement, with the milestones stated in the payment terms. The critical path is staged submission of temporary traffic diversion and utility diversion coordination; the contractor shall maintain critical-path buffer and shall not stop the whole line when diversion data arrives late. The contractor shall submit the first-stage temporary traffic diversion plan for review within 30 days after commencement, and shall submit each subsequent stage diversion submission document no less than 45 days before that stage implementation. The owner shall complete review and reply in writing within 14 working days after receiving complete submission documents; if no reply is given within that period, the contractor may proceed to prepare the next stage submission but the submission obligation is not excused. Each stage submission shall include the public information release arrangement, which shall be executed after owner review. These submission nodes and review time limits are the verification basis for the month 3 milestone; delay in owner review is not counted against the contractor schedule, but correction time caused by incomplete contractor documents is counted against the contractor schedule. The independent inspection node list shall be jointly confirmed by the contractor quality team and delivery team before commencement and filed with the owner for record before execution; subgrade layered compaction and settlement observation and pavement structural layer layer-by-layer inspection shall follow design documents and current standards. Witness sampling ledgers and batch traceability shall be submitted to the owner for review with progress reports. The team availability summary and the manning of safety and environmental positions for the full 24 months are the contractor pre-commencement verification items, not a submission precondition. negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: COMP-0167 supplies only materials and components for the construction package 口岸人工岛连接线路基与路面工程包: supply, transport to site, quality certification documents, and warranty-period replacement. Excluded: any construction, installation, temporary works, measure costs, and construction-interface responsibility. Materials cost is included in the parent construction package fixed price; COMP-0153 as the construction contractor is the buyer and pays. The construction package scope (used only to determine required materials, not part of this package) is about 18,500 square meters of subgrade treatment, pavement structural layers, drainage and ancillary civil works, including temporary traffic diversion and utility relocation within that package, excluding bridge-end structural transition sections. This package self-procures materials. Delivery handover is at the buyer-designated receiving point against acceptance records. Transport plan coordinates with the 口岸人工岛 connecting-line corridor conditions and temporary traffic diversion windows.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Total price MOP 20,490,000 with the bid breakdown unchanged. Unit prices for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料 are locked through completion of supply, covering all batches from first arrival to acceptance of the last batch, with no adjustment for material price index movement within that scope. For 排水与附属土建材料及构配件 only, the base is material price index 1.112; when the index moves beyond plus or minus 5%, the excess is settled batch by batch using 调价额 = 该批合同金额 x (当期指数 - 1.112) / 1.112; no adjustment when within the threshold. The previously listed 需澄清 unlocked portions are resolved by these two rules and no longer remain open. The MOP 760,000 price risk boundary is a risk provision under this lock-and-adjust mechanism and does not create additional exposure for the buyer. No uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope; any request beyond these rules remains unresolved and requires re-tendering. Acceptance standards lists for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料, plus the batch nonconformity isolation and written notification procedure, are contract attachments.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment per batch: within 30 days after that batch passes arrival acceptance, pay 80% of the batch price; the balance is settled after warranty expiry with no outstanding unrectified nonconformities. Payment nodes and ratios are written into the contract body and are not merely referenced to the bid document. Currency is MOP.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Batch arrival nodes follow the buyer-confirmed construction schedule; a batch arrival node table is a contract attachment specifying each batch advance-notice period and emergency replenishment arrangements. Each batch is preceded by advance notice to the buyer and accompanied by factory inspection reports and batch traceability records; the supplier cooperates with the buyer in completing arrival acceptance records. Quality documents use the unified format covering factory inspection, batch traceability, and arrival acceptance, with one-to-one batch numbering; independent sampling review and a rectification closed-loop apply. Warranty replacement: response within 24 hours for material nonconformity with design indicators or batch quality defects, and within 48 hours for transport arrival damage, after written notice; nonconforming batches are isolated and the buyer notified in writing within 24 hours, included in batch traceability and rectification closed loop. Replacement materials are re-issued quality documents and included in batch traceability. Team availability and role plan (supply coordination, quality document management, warranty response) are stated on a planned basis as a binding staffing obligation, not as already implemented. Alternative sources and emergency replenishment are accepted as stated risk allocation; portions without written supplier quotations are listed as internal estimates and are the supplier's risk.

Supplier COMP-0167 positions accepted and written as obligations: payment of 80% of each batch price within 30 days after arrival acceptance, balance after warranty expiry with no unrectified nonconformities; batch arrival node table as a contract attachment with advance-notice periods and emergency replenishment; warranty response within 24 hours for design-indicator nonconformity or batch defects and within 48 hours for transport damage, with batch isolation and written buyer notice within 24 hours. The supplier's disclosed assumptions on alternative sources and emergency replenishment internal estimates, planned-basis team availability, and the buyer being the construction contractor are accepted as stated risk allocations. bid_document.submission_summary:
本投标以单一供货方身份独立提交，不组组合体，不承担施工、安装、临时工程与施工界面责任。报价以固定单价为基础，已含运输到场、质量证明文件提交及质保期更换费用。

报价构成（MOP）：路基过渡与挡土段材料 2,860,000；结构衔接段预制构件与钢筋 4,120,000；交通节点金属结构与附属构配件 1,980,000；运输到场与进场物流 960,000；质量文档与独立抽样检查 385,000；质保期更换与备件 520,000；价格与付款风险边界准备 640,000。合计 11,465,000，在包预算 12,495,000 以内。

价格机制：固定单价，单价锁定区间以投标基准日材料价格指数1.112为基准，指数超出约定区间时按公开指数变动调整，调价触发条件在报价说明中统一口径。付款节点、账期、业主背书、质保年限与关键人员可用性摘要记录未载明，全部作为已披露假设并设现金流与价格风险边界，不作为提交前提。

terms.scope: 仅为施工包「大桥起止点衔接段与交通节点结构工程包」供应其施工所需的材料与构配件：供货、运输到场、质量证明文件和质保期内的更换。不含任何施工、安装、临时工程或措施费，也不承担施工界面责任。材料费用已包含在该施工包的合同价内，由该施工包的承包商作为买方支付。该施工包的工作内容（仅用于判断所需材料，不属于本包工作）：与澳氹第四条跨海大桥起止点衔接的路基过渡、挡土与结构衔接段、交通节点改造及相应临时交通组织；管线迁改与疏解的接口责任按设计接口清单归入本包或前一包，单点计价不重复。本包自行采购材料。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: 供货方COMP-0167以单一供货方身份独立履约，仅供应施工包CASE-0005/construction-2所需材料与构配件：路基过渡段填料与级配材料、挡土与结构衔接段混凝土预制构件及钢筋、交通节点改造用金属结构与附属构配件，并负责运输到场、随货质量证明文件与批次追溯记录、质保期内更换。合同不扩展至任何施工、安装、临时工程、措施费或施工界面责任；管线迁改与疏解接口责任不属本包。供货方设供货总协调人一名作为对买方COMP-0191的单一接口，并提交采购与排产、质量与文档、物流到场、售后与备件四个职能口负责人名单；关键人员名单与可用性摘要按投标文件保留，作为履约期落实事项，不作为提交前提。随货提供材料与施工安装的接口要求（尺寸公差、连接构造、养护与存放条件）供买方协调，供货方不承担界面责任。
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: 合同价为11,465,000 MOP，采用固定单价，在24个月工期内全额锁定，不设材料价格指数调整机制；删除锁定区间外按公开指数调价的表述，材料价格指数1.112偏高部分由投标报价中已含的价格与付款风险边界准备640,000 MOP覆盖，合同价在工期内不作调整。各材料数量与单价为按施工包设计规格的估算，非已收供应商报价，按投标文件保留为已披露风险分配，结算按实际交付并验收合格的批次数量乘以锁定单价计算，单价不因数量估算偏差而调整。任何超出上述锁定机制的调价、新增工作或范围扩展均不属本合同授权范围，须另行处理并重新招标；本合同不设未封顶的价格调整。
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: 每批材料到场并经买方验收合格后30日内，支付该批货值的80%；余款20%在质保期满且无未决更换事项后结清。账期不因业主付款延迟而顺延。付款以买方书面确认单签认及该批质量证明文件与抽样检查报告提交并确认为条件。全部批次到场并验收后结清全部余款。付款条件以本条为准，不引用任何未载明的外部付款节点。
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: 供货到场计划按24个月工期倒排，分四至五批交付，末批预留备件与替换料。首批路基过渡段材料的最迟到场日期由买方进度计划负责人在合同附件中固化，作为24个月工期倒排的起点；投标文件中待与施工包承包商书面确认的表述改为以该附件节点为准。每批到场前，供货方提交批次清单与质量证明文件；到场后按买方通知时限内完成独立抽样检查，抽样检查由供货方组织、买方见证，检验报告随批次提交。每批到场时间、卸货交接条件与随货质量证明以双方书面确认单固化，确认单签署后即成为供货义务。质保期自该批到场验收合格之日起24个月；不合格材料更换响应时限为买方书面通知后7日内到场更换，关键构配件常备库存替换渠道48小时内启动；质保年限与响应时限在合同附件中写明，不再作为未决假设。
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: 已采纳买方COMP-0191的接受前提：第1项价格条款按24个月全额锁定、删除指数调价口子、640,000 MOP风险准备覆盖锁定风险、合同价11,465,000 MOP不作调整；第2项付款条款按每批验收合格后30日内付80%、余20%质保期满且无未决更换事项后结清、账期不因业主付款延迟顺延。第3项首批最迟到场日期由买方进度计划负责人在合同附件中固化并作为倒排起点；第4项质量证明文件、批次追溯编号管理与独立抽样检查写成明确合同义务并载明提交时点；第5项质保年限与响应时限在合同附件中写明。对供货方COMP-0167的反馈：其第1项付款口径与买方第2项不一致，以买方条款为准；其第2项质保24个月与7日更换、48小时替换渠道已采纳；其第3项正负5%指数调价区间与买方第1项全额锁定冲突，不予采纳，按全额锁定执行；其第4项批次节点以买方附件节点为准；其第5项责任边界与独立抽样检查安排已采纳；其第6项关键人员可用性摘要与数量单价估算按投标文件保留为履约期落实事项。上述冲突项已由买方决定，不等待外部文件；如供货方不接受全额锁定价格条款，则本合同条款未达成一致，须重新招标。双方均保留拒绝本稿的权利。

bid_document.technical_proposal: 江苏乾堪建设工程有限公司以单一投标人身份独立投标，不组建组合体。技术方案围绕口岸人工岛连接线总体及施工图设计协调与24个月现场设计配合展开：总体设计阶段以接线标高与既有路网、管线迁改时序咬合为主线，同步开展口岸运营交通疏解分阶段设计；施工图阶段按专业出图计划推进，BIM与MEP协调、结构衔接与沉降控制以分包加审查门方式组织，接口责任在角色计划中明确由我方承担。现场设计配合纳入固定包价，承诺施工期响应时限与驻场安排。独立设计审查机制按披露假设写入：审查节点设在总体设计定稿、施工图出图前与重大变更三处，审查记录按可追溯编号归档，执行方待判给后与业主确认，审查组织责任由我方承担。可持续与质量目标通过耐久性构造、可维护性设计及能源使用目标落实措施体现。
bid_document.implementation_plan: 第1至4个月完成总体设计及管线迁改与交通疏解接口协调计划，提交业主审查；第5至12个月分专业推进施工图设计，穿插BIM与MEP协调审查门及结构衔接沉降专项审查；第13至24个月进入施工期现场设计配合，按响应时限派驻现场设计人员，处理变更设计与接口协调。设计里程碑与业主审查时间安排在投标文件中以进度视图列明，关键人员投入时段按披露假设预留风险边界。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: 范围维持总体及施工图设计与现场设计配合；价格MOP 4,500,000、币种、成员COMP-0295（资源承诺0.25）与工作份额不变。独立设计审查执行方须在合同生效前经业主书面同意，该确认作为合同生效前置条件，未确认则合同不生效；未获书面同意前，不得以投标人自审替代独立审查，亦不得进入施工图出图节点。审查节点维持总体设计定稿、施工图出图前与重大变更三处，由COMP-0295组织，记录按可追溯编号归档并作为支付评估依据，执行方确认安排写入合同附件。持份者沟通计划与争议处理路径（对应接口协调与持份者协调费MOP 520,000）列为总体设计阶段第4个月末提交业主审查的可验收交付物，须至少覆盖分阶段交通影响应对方案、口岸运营方对接人与沟通路径、争议升级与处理路径；业主审查不通过的，COMP-0295须在业主书面意见发出后10个工作日内补正并重新送审，补正期间不计入业主审查时限。BIM与MEP协调、结构衔接与沉降控制按分包加审查门方式组织，接口责任由COMP-0295在角色计划中明确承担。
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: 固定包价MOP 4,500,000与包预算一致，现场设计配合已含于固定包价。投标文件所列披露假设（独立设计审查执行方、关键人员24个月投入时段、分包报价未落实）的风险由COMP-0295承担；固定包价不因执行方或人员变动而调整，亦不构成业主额外付款依据。变更设计按招标文件写明的计费规则单列计量与支付审查，不并入固定包价；范围与预算变更须经宏观审批，COMP-0295不自行扩大范围。本稿不新增任何未授权的价格调整机制。

本投标以单一责任主体身份提交，服务范围严格限定为造价咨询与合同成本管理：工程量清单审核、变更计价技术评估与独立复核、支付申请独立复核、成本预警与变更评估、计量确认独立检查记录、成果复核节点与文档归档；不包含政府审批与现场监理，亦不越界承诺任何审批结果。

独立复核链是本方案的核心：支付申请复核、计量确认独立检查与变更计价技术评估由三名分离人员分别签认，计价编制人员不参与对其自身成果的复核；每份独立检查记录载明复核人、复核日期、依据版本与结论，形成可追溯的签认链。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: Scope remains exactly as stated: about 18,500 square metres of subgrade treatment, pavement structural layers, drainage and ancillary civil works, including temporary traffic diversion and utility diversion implementation within this package; excluding the bridge start and end structural connection sections. This package self-procures materials. The contractor shall implement temporary traffic diversion on a submit-first-then-commence basis, staged submission and staged implementation, and shall record the diversion submission objects, staged submission nodes and public information arrangements in the coordination clause as a binding obligation subject to owner review; these are obligations, not completed approvals. The contractor shall maintain an interface coordination register with MEP and drainage interface parties and shall sequence work after interface data is available. Utility diversion base data is per the tender documents actually provided; where data is insufficient the contractor shall keep the critical path moving on workable sections without stopping the whole line, and shall bear the coordination and rework boundary as an accepted risk allocation. The contractor shall complete emergency drills and crew training before the rainy season and shall provide temporary sedimentation and flow diversion at drainage interfaces. The team availability summary and the draft work-sequence and independent inspection node list are accepted as proposed-input statements only; they shall be firmed up as quality plan attachments during delivery and are not a condition of this acceptance.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: The contract price is 74,620,000 MOP, fixed for the stated scope, and remains unchanged in price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitments. Measurement, valuation and payment under this contract shall be governed solely by the unified bill-of-quantities basis and the price adjustment factors and base values issued under cost consulting package COMP-0169. Any basis, index treatment or risk boundary stated in the bidder submission is for quotation explanation only and shall not override or supplement the COMP-0169 basis. Pending issuance of the COMP-0169 basis text, the parties shall adopt it without change to price, currency, scope, members or resource commitments. The provisional sum shall be used per the COMP-0169 basis once issued and only for owner-instructed changes and unforeseeable matters, not diverted to other uses. Price adjustment uses material index 1.0545 and labor index 1.0980 as base values with adjustable factors per the owner bill-of-quantities basis; upward exposure is covered by the risk reserve together with the price adjustment clause. Safety and environmental投入 is a non-compressible cost and shall not be reduced. No uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope; any request requiring a change to price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares or resource commitments remains unresolved and needs re-tendering.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in MOP against measured quantities valued solely on the COMP-0169 unified bill-of-quantities basis, subject to owner measurement and payment review. Milestone-linked payment events are: submission of the traffic diversion plan and construction preparation by month 3; completion of main subgrade treatment by month 9; completion of drainage, ancillary civil works and utility diversion implementation by month 16; completion of pavement structural layers by month 21; and completion of testing, as-built documentation and handover by month 24. Each milestone payment is conditional on owner acceptance of the corresponding verified records, including layered subgrade compaction and settlement observation records, layer-by-layer pavement inspection and acceptance, witness sampling ledgers and batch traceability submitted with progress reports. The provisional sum is paid only against owner written instruction. The contractor shall not reduce inspection frequency to accelerate work.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: The contractor shall complete all construction content of this package within 24 months from commencement, with the milestones stated in the payment terms. The critical path is staged submission of temporary traffic diversion and utility diversion coordination; the contractor shall maintain critical-path buffer and shall not stop the whole line when diversion data arrives late. The contractor shall submit the first-stage temporary traffic diversion plan for review within 30 days after commencement, and shall submit each subsequent stage diversion submission document no less than 45 days before that stage implementation. The owner shall complete review and reply in writing within 14 working days after receiving complete submission documents; if no reply is given within that period, the contractor may proceed to prepare the next stage submission but the submission obligation is not excused. Each stage submission shall include the public information release arrangement, which shall be executed after owner review. These submission nodes and review time limits are the verification basis for the month 3 milestone; delay in owner review is not counted against the contractor schedule, but correction time caused by incomplete contractor documents is counted against the contractor schedule. The independent inspection node list shall be jointly confirmed by the contractor quality team and delivery team before commencement and filed with the owner for record before execution; subgrade layered compaction and settlement observation and pavement structural layer layer-by-layer inspection shall follow design documents and current standards. Witness sampling ledgers and batch traceability shall be submitted to the owner for review with progress reports. The team availability summary and the manning of safety and environmental positions for the full 24 months are the contractor pre-commencement verification items, not a submission precondition. The contractor shall submit quality records, witness sampling ledgers and progress reports at owner review nodes. The contractor shall complete testing, as-built documentation and handover by month 24.

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: COMP-0167 supplies only materials and components for the construction package 口岸人工岛连接线路基与路面工程包: supply, transport to site, quality certification documents, and warranty-period replacement. Excluded: any construction, installation, temporary works, measure costs, and construction-interface responsibility. Materials cost is included in the parent construction package fixed price; COMP-0153 as the construction contractor is the buyer and pays. The construction package scope (used only to determine required materials, not part of this package) is about 18,500 square meters of subgrade treatment, pavement structural layers, drainage and ancillary civil works, including temporary traffic diversion and utility relocation within that package, excluding bridge-end structural transition sections. This package self-procures materials. Delivery handover is at the buyer-designated receiving point against acceptance records. Transport plan coordinates with the 口岸人工岛 connecting-line corridor conditions and temporary traffic diversion windows.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Total price MOP 20,490,000 with the bid breakdown unchanged. Unit prices for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料 are locked through completion of supply, covering all batches from first arrival to acceptance of the last batch, with no adjustment for material price index movement within that scope. For 排水与附属土建材料及构配件 only, the base is material price index 1.112; when the index moves beyond plus or minus 5%, the excess is settled batch by batch using 调价额 = 该批合同金额 x (当期指数 - 1.112) / 1.112; no adjustment when within the threshold. The previously listed 需澄清 unlocked portions are resolved by these two rules and no longer remain open. The MOP 760,000 price risk boundary is a risk provision under this lock-and-adjust mechanism and does not create additional exposure for the buyer. No uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope; any request beyond these rules remains unresolved and requires re-tendering. Acceptance standards lists for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料, plus the batch nonconformity isolation and written notification procedure, are contract attachments.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment per batch: within 30 days after that batch passes arrival acceptance, pay 80% of the batch price; the balance is settled after warranty expiry with no outstanding unrectified nonconformities. Payment nodes and ratios are written into the contract body and are not merely referenced to the bid document. Currency is MOP.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Batch arrival nodes follow the buyer-confirmed construction schedule; a batch arrival node table is a contract attachment specifying each batch advance-notice period and emergency replenishment arrangements. Each batch is preceded by advance notice to the buyer and accompanied by factory inspection reports and batch traceability records; the supplier cooperates with the buyer in completing arrival acceptance records. Quality documents use the unified format covering factory inspection, batch traceability, and arrival acceptance, with one-to-one batch numbering; independent sampling review and a rectification closed-loop apply. Warranty replacement: response within 24 hours for material nonconformity with design indicators or batch quality defects, and within 48 hours for transport arrival damage, after written notice; nonconforming batches are isolated and the buyer notified in writing within 24 hours, included in batch traceability and rectification closed loop. Replacement materials are re-issued quality documents and included in batch traceability. Team availability and role plan (supply coordination, quality document management, warranty response) are stated on a planned basis as a binding staffing obligation, not as already implemented. Alternative sources and emergency replenishment are accepted as stated risk allocation; portions without written supplier quotations are listed as internal estimates and are the supplier's risk.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0153 decisions are binding: (1) unit prices for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料 are locked through completion of supply across all batches, with no index adjustment in that scope; (2) index adjustment applies only to 排水与附属土建材料及构配件, base 1.112, threshold plus or minus 5%, formula 调价额 = 该批合同金额 x (当期指数 - 1.112) / 1.112, settled batch by batch; (3) the former 需澄清 unlocked portions are closed by rules (1) and (2), and the MOP 760,000 price risk boundary is a risk provision under this mechanism, not additional buyer exposure; (4) acceptance standards lists for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料 and the batch nonconformity isolation and written notification procedure are contract attachments. Supplier COMP-0167 positions accepted and written as obligations: payment of 80% of each batch price within 30 days after arrival acceptance, balance after warranty expiry with no unrectified nonconformities; batch arrival node table as a contract attachment with advance-notice periods and emergency replenishment; warranty response within 24 hours for design-indicator nonconformity or batch defects and within 48 hours for transport damage, with batch isolation and written buyer notice within 24 hours. The supplier's disclosed assumptions on alternative sources and emergency replenishment internal estimates, planned-basis team availability, and the buyer being the construction contractor are accepted as stated risk allocations. Price MOP 20,490,000, currency MOP, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitment 0.25 are unchanged; no uncapped price adjustment is added, and any request beyond these rules remains unresolved and requires re-tendering. negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: 供货方COMP-0167以单一供货方身份独立履约，仅供应施工包CASE-0005/construction-2所需材料与构配件：路基过渡段填料与级配材料、挡土与结构衔接段混凝土预制构件及钢筋、交通节点改造用金属结构与附属构配件，并负责运输到场、随货质量证明文件与批次追溯记录、质保期内更换。合同不扩展至任何施工、安装、临时工程、措施费或施工界面责任；管线迁改与疏解接口责任不属本包。供货方设供货总协调人一名作为对买方COMP-0191的单一接口，并提交采购与排产、质量与文档、物流到场、售后与备件四个职能口负责人名单；关键人员名单与可用性摘要按投标文件保留，作为履约期落实事项，不作为提交前提。随货提供材料与施工安装的接口要求（尺寸公差、连接构造、养护与存放条件）供买方协调，供货方不承担界面责任。
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: 合同价为11,465,000 MOP，采用固定单价，在24个月工期内全额锁定，不设材料价格指数调整机制；删除锁定区间外按公开指数调价的表述，材料价格指数1.112偏高部分由投标报价中已含的价格与付款风险边界准备640,000 MOP覆盖，合同价在工期内不作调整。各材料数量与单价为按施工包设计规格的估算，非已收供应商报价，按投标文件保留为已披露风险分配，结算按实际交付并验收合格的批次数量乘以锁定单价计算，单价不因数量估算偏差而调整。任何超出上述锁定机制的调价、新增工作或范围扩展均不属本合同授权范围，须另行处理并重新招标；本合同不设未封顶的价格调整。
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: 每批材料到场并经买方验收合格后30日内，支付该批货值的80%；余款20%在质保期满且无未决更换事项后结清。账期不因业主付款延迟而顺延。付款以买方书面确认单签认及该批质量证明文件与抽样检查报告提交并确认为条件。全部批次到场并验收后结清全部余款。付款条件以本条为准，不引用任何未载明的外部付款节点。
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: 供货到场计划按24个月工期倒排，分四至五批交付，末批预留备件与替换料。首批路基过渡段材料的最迟到场日期由买方进度计划负责人在合同附件中固化，作为24个月工期倒排的起点；投标文件中待与施工包承包商书面确认的表述改为以该附件节点为准。每批到场前，供货方提交批次清单与质量证明文件；到场后按买方通知时限内完成独立抽样检查，抽样检查由供货方组织、买方见证，检验报告随批次提交。每批到场时间、卸货交接条件与随货质量证明以双方书面确认单固化，确认单签署后即成为供货义务。质保期自该批到场验收合格之日起24个月；不合格材料更换响应时限为买方书面通知后7日内到场更换，关键构配件常备库存替换渠道48小时内启动；质保年限与响应时限在合同附件中写明，不再作为未决假设。
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: 已采纳买方COMP-0191的接受前提：第1项价格条款按24个月全额锁定、删除指数调价口子、640,000 MOP风险准备覆盖锁定风险、合同价11,465,000 MOP不作调整；第2项付款条款按每批验收合格后30日内付80%、余20%质保期满且无未决更换事项后结清、账期不因业主付款延迟顺延。第3项首批最迟到场日期由买方进度计划负责人在合同附件中固化并作为倒排起点；第4项质量证明文件、批次追溯编号管理与独立抽样检查写成明确合同义务并载明提交时点；第5项质保年限与响应时限在合同附件中写明。对供货方COMP-0167的反馈：其第1项付款口径与买方第2项不一致，以买方条款为准；其第2项质保24个月与7日更换、48小时替换渠道已采纳；其第3项正负5%指数调价区间与买方第1项全额锁定冲突，不予采纳，按全额锁定执行；其第4项批次节点以买方附件节点为准；其第5项责任边界与独立抽样检查安排已采纳；其第6项关键人员可用性摘要与数量单价估算按投标文件保留为履约期落实事项。上述冲突项已由买方决定，不等待外部文件；如供货方不接受全额锁定价格条款，则本合同条款未达成一致，须重新招标。双方均保留拒绝本稿的权利。
